0022600110.text: The Denver Nuggets (0-1, 11th in the West) host the New Orleans Pelicans (0-2, 10th in the West) in the second game of Denver's season, with both teams still seeking their first win. Denver is without Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Alpha Diallo (wrist) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while New Orleans is without Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Denver won all three games against New Orleans in 2025-26, most recently a 122-116 road win on January 13, 2026.
